title: Greywater Bay Rising Revisited
author: Astrid Galloway
blurb: Noor Halloran, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
